base_member_text: fdir_results is a hard-coded personal path (L4); snapshot numbering files=[33:150] with '%.5d' names and frame time labeled as 'numb s' (L141) assumes 1-s output intervals -- not derivable here.
audit_member_text: The configured result directory at L4 is an absolute user-specific path; none of the repeated loads at L39-L98 checks file existence or verifies that transposed vectors match x from the base dep width at L13.

base_member_text: Panels 8,3 index 16/17-18 plot Cb then Ca but the legend calls Ca 'capped Cb' (L250); axis for zoom panel L247 uses [0 65] not the [34 44] zoom of its siblings.
audit_member_text: The detail Cb/Ca panel at L241-L250 repeats axis([0 65 ...]) from the full-domain panel L230-L239 instead of using the 34..44 detail range used by adjacent paired panels; this is a copy-pattern inconsistency.

base_member_text: The zoom bed-change panel sums only Ds+Db (L299) while labeling the red curve 'Tot' (L303); the full-domain panel includes Aval (L286) -- inconsistent totals between panels.
audit_member_text: The full-domain total bed-change curve includes Aval at L286, but the detail total curve omits Aval at L299 while retaining an Ava curve and four-entry legend at L295-L303; the two Tot curves therefore have different definitions.

base_member_text: Sediment constants are re-hardcoded here (L114-121: D50=0.00012, WS=0.07, Sdensity=2.68, Shields_cr=0.05; grav=9.8 vs 9.81 in Fr L105) as a manual cross-check of sediment.F output; whether they match the actual input.txt of this benchmark run cannot be verified from this file.
audit_member_text: Froude uses gravitational acceleration 9.81 at L105 while sediment critical stress uses grav=9.8 from L117 at L121, creating an unexplained within-script constant mismatch.

base_member_text: Tau_xy (L125) and TauEx (L88-90), picka/Pavg (L72-74), uu/etaa (L100-101), WS and viscosity (L115, L118) are computed/loaded but never plotted or used.
audit_member_text: Tau_xy is calculated at L125 but never plotted or otherwise consumed; the stress panels use str and Tau_cr at L255-L275, so the computed formula cannot affect the video.
picka, TauEx, uu, etaa, WS, and viscosity are loaded or assigned at L73-L74,L89-L90,L100-L101,L115,L118 but not consumed by active diagnostics.
Fr can become complex or nonfinite when dep'+eta is nonpositive at L105; masking only applies where mask<1 at L102-L103 and no positivity check guards the square root.
